summary: Declare what claimed work waits on with `st work wait --on`: a pull request, another step or a time. st wakes the seat when it moves, shows the step as waiting on it, and does not nudge the idle seat about it meanwhile

replay.detail: No projection replay is needed. work.wait-ended is a retained event on a step: the run projection skips it, as it skips work.nudged, and the step views read it with one indexed lookup of the step's newest claims.

schema.detail: No tables, columns or indexes change. The claim vocabulary gains work.wait-ended (system-only, append, on step-run) with optional attempt, wait, reason and message fields, and the work claims gain an optional wait_on object. The client contract adds optional waiting_on and waiting_since_unix_ms to work.

rules.detail: work.wait-ended is classified as durable in retention.toml and has no checkpoint drop rule. Checkpoint rules and their digests are unchanged. The claim registry digest changes with the new kind: members on different builds keep replicating claims and skip comparing projection maps until all are upgraded.

compatibility.detail: An older st rejects `work wait --on` as an unknown flag. An older daemon refuses a wait with --on and no --for, and records one with --for as a note, ignoring wait_on. A member on an older build holds a replicated work.wait-ended as unknown and admits it after it upgrades; its clock fold then restarts the step's execution clock at the end of the wait. Only the host that runs a step's run evaluates its waits. Not tested against an older build.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs at startup. Each held step's wait is checked during its run's existing evaluation, with one indexed read of the step's newest claims and one read of its target; a time wait arms the run's evaluation deadline at its time.

manual.detail: Seats learn it from `st work wait --help` and the st skill. The guide is in docs/st3/mission-graph-runtime.md under Declared waits.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary. Declared waits are then notes: their clocks stay stopped until resume or the wait's deadline, nothing ends them, and work.wait-ended claims stay in the graph unread.
